title: Multimodal Support in Gen AI Studio Playground
assumptions: Local snapshot is authoritative for this run; clarified strategy takes precedence over broader original business request.
10 MB is a provisional demo file limit, pending PM and proxy-capacity validation.
Model names and capabilities are illustrative fixtures, not claims about actual deployed models.
No persona catalog was present in the staged plugin; model-explorer and endpoint-owner are inferred roles.
Backend file IDs, server-side encoding, ASR, Responses API, timing, storage isolation and replicas are simulated, not implemented or validated.
Endpoint registrations persist only in browser sessionStorage. Chats are not persisted.
Model selection is locked after attachment selection or submission; New chat resets it.
Microphone, PDFs, audio output, multiple attachments, comparison and chat persistence are excluded per clarified strategy.
limitations: Local HTTP server blocked by permission controls; browser rendering and interaction checks were not performed.
PatternFly styling requires access to the CDN.
Prototype Bar Eval points to a future evaluation report; no evaluation or batch export was requested.
